professionalSummary: Project Manager with proven experience delivering digital change projects across multiple engineering squads, managing change approvals, running pilot workshops, and reporting progress to senior sponsors.
experienceHighlights: Planned and tracked delivery for the account-opening rebuild at Tamberline Credit Union, running fortnightly planning with the product owner and two engineering squads against a single release plan.

Took 23 releases through the change-approval board, each submitted with an impact assessment, test evidence and a back-out plan; the board deferred two of them, which were re-submitted the following week.
Ran six pilot workshops with members and branch staff to test the new online application before launch, recording every change request raised in the sessions.
Sent a monthly progress report to the chief operating officer covering milestones, the risk log and spend against the approved budget.
Worked with the financial-crime team on the identity-verification step of the application, documenting which checks the vendor's service runs.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Pilot workshop log: six sessions with dates and attendee groups, 31 change requests raised and the product owner's decision on each one.
